title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-04-15
source: Sony 770 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-(Bob Mathews); DAT x Zero (DL) > DAT x One (RE) > DAT x Two (JW); play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name) by Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Crisp 1970 soundboard captures a hard‑rocking marathon set highlighted by an epic Cryptical → Other One suite and standout versions of Man’s World, Candyman, Dancing in the Streets and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is a very clear soundboard capture with only occasional tape cuts that don’t detract from its overall brilliance. The show itself is praised as a quintessential spring‑1970 performance, featuring a soaring Cryptical Envelopment → The Other One jam, powerful renditions of Man’s World and Dancing in the Streets, and an energetic flow throughout the single long set.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are overwhelmingly positive (mostly 5‑star) and highlight both superb musical moments and high‑quality soundboard audio, with only minor mentions of tape cuts.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix praised by several reviewers; occasional tape cuts/patches and missing sections noted but do not majorly impact listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A single, continuous long set typical of early‑1970 Winterland shows, flowing smoothly through jams and transitions with a strong climax around the Cryptical → Other One suite.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for dynamic change‑ups and leading the band back into Cryptical Envelopment during the jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ/harmonica presence noted; possible guest keyboardist from Airplane or Quicksilver mentioned but not identified.
